mapper.sql: id, task_no, task_type, biz_type, biz_id, user_id, status, progress, retry_count, payload_json, result_json, error_message, next_retry_at, create_time, update_time, finished_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_async_task (task_no, task_type, biz_type, biz_id, user_id, status, progress, retry_count, payload_json, result_json, error_message, next_retry_at, create_time, update_time, finished_time) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{taskType}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{progress}, 0, #{payloadJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, NULL, NULL, #{nextRetryAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_async_task WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_async_task SET status = 'RUNNING', progress = #{progress}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE sys_async_task SET status = #{status}, progress = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 100 ELSE progress END, result_json = #{resultJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'PENDING')

UPDATE sys_async_task SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
UPDATE sys_async_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
UPDATE sys_async_task SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_retry_at = NOW(), error_message = '任务超时未完成，已自动回收', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
